about: What camctl Studio knows per camera maker and model. 'tested' means checked with a real camera; everything else is untested and says so on screen. Sources: the PTP standard (ISO 15740), libgphoto2's camlibs/ptp2 (codes only), Sony Camera Remote SDK, Canon EDSDK / CCAPI and Nikon SDK documentation (references only, nothing from them is bundled). Updated 15 Nov 2026 (Wi-Fi routes for every maker with a documented protocol).

Sony.status: tested on one ZV-E10 (firmware 2.03); other models untested
camera_setup: MENU > Network > PC Remote Function > PC Remote: On.
USB: PC Remote Function > USB connection: PC Remote.
Sony.windows: USB needs the WinUSB driver for the camera (Zadig); Studio never installs drivers. Wi-Fi needs none.

Canon.status: untested: written from the public PTP codes, never run on a Canon; Wi-Fi route untested too
wifi_setup: MENU > Wireless settings > Wi-Fi function > Remote control (EOS Utility): put the camera on your Wi-Fi and pair it with this PC the first time.
camera_setup: Switch the camera on, mode dial to M (Studio cannot turn the dial).
Wi-Fi / Bluetooth off while the USB cable is used.
Canon.notes: EOS and EOS R bodies only (older PowerShots have no remote mode). Mode dial and the AF/MF switch stay on the camera.
Canon.windows: USB needs the WinUSB driver for the camera (Zadig); Studio never installs drivers.

Nikon.status: untested: written from the public PTP codes, never run on a Nikon; Wi-Fi route untested too
wifi_setup: Network menu > Connect to computer (Z bodies; older bodies with built-in Wi-Fi or a WU-1a / WU-1b adapter). Pair it with this PC on the camera the first time.
camera_setup: Switch the camera on, mode dial (or exposure mode) to M.
Some Z bodies: MENU > Setup > USB: MTP/PTP.
Nikon.windows: USB needs the WinUSB driver for the camera (Zadig); Studio never installs drivers.

Fujifilm.status: untested: standard PTP only (settings it lists, shutter); no live picture over USB; Wi-Fi route untested too
wifi_setup: Connection setting > PC Shoot / PC connection over Wi-Fi (bodies FUJIFILM X Acquire controls over Wi-Fi, such as X-T3, X-T4, X-H2). Pair it with this PC on the camera.

Panasonic.status: untested: standard PTP only; no live picture over USB; Wi-Fi route untested too
wifi_setup: Wi-Fi > Wi-Fi Function > New Connection > Remote Shooting & View; join the camera's Wi-Fi network from this PC and confirm the connection on the camera.

OM System / Olympus.status: untested: standard PTP only; no live picture over USB; Wi-Fi route untested too
wifi_setup: Connection to Smartphone (or the Wi-Fi button): join the camera's own Wi-Fi network from this PC.

Ricoh / Pentax.status: untested: standard PTP only; no live picture over USB; Wi-Fi route untested too
wifi_setup: Switch the camera's Wi-Fi on (GR: Setup > Wi-Fi; Pentax K-1 / KP / K-3 III: Wireless LAN) and join its network from this PC.

Leica.status: untested: standard PTP only; no live picture

Blackmagic.status: not supported (controlled over its own Bluetooth / REST API)

models.checked: connect, settings, live view, photo, Photo/Video, power zoom, focus tap, saved setups (11-12 Nov 2026)

sony.what: Sony's PTP extension (the same protocol Sony's Camera Remote SDK uses), USB or Wi-Fi

canon.what: Canon EOS PTP extension over USB or Wi-Fi (PTP/IP): settings, live view, photo, video, focus

nikon.what: Standard PTP plus Nikon's extension over USB or Wi-Fi (PTP/IP): settings, live view, photo, video, focus

ptp-generic.what: Plain ISO 15740 PTP over USB: the settings a camera lists, shutter release, files

fuji.what: Fujifilm over Wi-Fi (PTP over TCP, ports 55740-55742): settings, shutter, live picture, video

lumix.what: Panasonic LUMIX over Wi-Fi (the camera's cam.cgi remote protocol): settings, live picture, shutter, video, zoom, focus

olympus.what: OM System / Olympus over Wi-Fi (the OI.Share protocol): settings, live picture, shutter, photo download, focus point

ricoh.what: Ricoh GR / Pentax over Wi-Fi (the camera's /v1 HTTP API): settings, live picture, shutter, photo download, video, focus point

gphoto2.what: Any camera libgphoto2 knows, through the optional gphoto2 package (Linux / macOS only)

sdk.what: Official maker SDKs (Sony Camera Remote SDK, Canon EDSDK, Nikon SDK): plug-in point only. Their licences do not allow shipping them in this MIT project; a user who registered can add an adapter on their own computer.
